publisher: Utah Division of Corporations and Commercial Code / Utah.gov
ownership: Official Utah Business List Service three-sheet registered-business product.
allowed_use: offline person-free normalization of explicitly operator-derived JSONL
local organization-registration review with authenticity caveat
prohibited_use: retaining or exporting applicants, principals, officers, partners, registered agents, or other natural-person data
representing an administrative address as a physical operating site
representing registration status as verified current operation
attribution: Source: Utah Business List Service, Utah.gov.
retention: Keep operator inputs and person-free projections local pending a source-specific retention and rights review.
redistribution: Not authorized by this profile; outputs are local-review-only.
personal_data_handling: The original workbook is retained locally only to bind original bytes. BUSINFO, PRINCIPAL, Applicant Name, and other person-bearing fields are validated for package structure but never emitted. The JSONL transformation is operator-derived and not treated as source-native or reproducibly verified.
